substantive_checks.bessel_seed: PASS: the factorial polynomial A_n(X) satisfies A_n=(4n-2)A_(n-1)+X^2A_(n-2), and evaluation at X=-1 and X=1 gives q_n=(-1)^n y_n(-2) and p_n=y_n(2)
substantive_checks.e_convergent_index: PASS: the three-step Euler-CF block has the same recurrence and boundary values, so p_n/q_n is the zero-based convergent 3n-2, including n=2 at index 4
substantive_checks.wronskian_and_minimum: PASS: the alternating Wronskian gives the fixed RHS; coprimality makes all beta solutions one class a^2 modulo q_n, whose centered representative has minimum absolute value rho_n; beta=0 is impossible
substantive_checks.inhomogeneous_coordinate: PASS: the convergent-error sign gives s_n(beta e-J)=2a/b-beta eta_n, and the next-denominator inequality yields the displayed sharp moving-center window under a hypothetical half-bound failure
substantive_checks.homogeneous_fixed_power_scope: PASS: discarding the moving center and using only |beta e-J|<1/n with a fixed-power homogeneous lower bound yields only a polynomial lower scale for rho_n
substantive_checks.nonprimitive_repair: PASS AFTER REPAIR: the fixed-RHS pair (J,beta) need not be primitive; reducing by d=gcd(J,beta), applying the primitive rational-approximation bound at v=|beta|/d, and scaling back proves the claimed 1/[|beta| log(2|beta|)] lower bound
substantive_checks.regular_cf_descent: PASS WITH SCOPE: the adjacent-convergent basis recognizes the same centered square residue and does not prove the half-bound; this is not stated as an impossibility theorem for an inhomogeneous or Ostrowski analysis
substantive_checks.proper_target: PASS: centering modulo Q|q_n can only reduce the residue, and the fixed-RHS minimum persists with modulus Q, but the e-Pade error coordinate is tied to the full q_n denominator
substantive_checks.capacity: PASS: the all-n half-bound, an O(n)-height lift, every large proper-target theorem, and the Item282 product baseline remain open; booking and beta capacity reduction are zero

strict_scope.proved: The exact reverse-Bessel/e-convergent recognition, fixed-RHS least-lift minimization, moving inhomogeneous coordinate, and a quantitative barrier for methods that discard that center and use only homogeneous irrationality estimates.
strict_scope.not_proved: The all-n half-bound, a superlinear least-lift lower bound, an O(n)-height lift, any large proper-target residue theorem, or any control of the product baseline.
strict_scope.next_exact_target: Use the sharp nearest-integer window and the arithmetic-progression Bessel seed in a genuine inhomogeneous congruence or descent argument.
strict_scope.open: Every positive beta-capacity theorem, the Item282 baseline, Route 1, and every conclusion about e+pi.
